name: The Princess

crownPassive.text: At upkeep, heal 1 to one of your cards, chosen at random.
crownPassive.name: Blessing of Silene

bond.text: Her heals restore +1 for each other Albion hero you field.
bond.name: Royal grace

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

actions.name: Mend
actions.text: Heal 1 to each of your adjacent cards.

actions.name: Girdle Leash
actions.text: An enemy Beast can't act this round. She can leash each Beast only once a fight.

notes: Girdle Leash comes from the design-system mock-up and the lore cards.
